summary.text: Erin Byrnes is a Democratic member of the Michigan House of Representatives for District 15, which covers the west end of Dearborn and Dearborn Heights.
Her Michigan House Democrats biography says she is serving a second term, is Assistant Whip of the Democratic Caucus, and sits on the Education and Workforce and Families and Veterans committees.

paragraphs.text: Byrnes grew up in Dearborn, the daughter of a city public works employee and a health care worker, according to her House Democrats biography.

She earned a bachelor's degree in women's and gender studies from the University of Michigan-Dearborn and a Master of Science in Education while working as a middle school special education teacher in New York City.
After returning to Michigan she worked as an educator at the University of Michigan and completed the Michigan Political Leadership Program at Michigan State University in 2015.
Byrnes served on the Dearborn City Council from 2018 to 2023.

The biography also lists her as an executive board member of the Progressive Women's Caucus and says her priorities include ethics and transparency, voting rights, reproductive rights, education and pay equity.
